inputs.name: auditRunnerFiles.kind
inputs.description: The ProjectKind of the project being scaffolded. It is inserted verbatim inside single quotes as the --profile value of the generated scripts/harness-audit.ts, which selects the audit profile that script runs; the function does not validate or escape it at runtime.

outputs.name: auditRunnerFiles
outputs.description: The file plan that auditRunnerFiles returns, which project.ts spreads into its app and lib file plans: a one-element array holding a PlannedFile at scripts/harness-audit.ts whose contents are a script that spawns `harness audit . --profile <kind>` (through `bun` on HARNESS_CLI_PATH when that variable is set, otherwise through the `harness` command) and exits with the child's exit code. The function only returns this array and performs no file I/O.
